scientific_integrity: Exhaustive characteristic-three coefficient and symmetry enumeration with Groebner smoothness tests, explicit Cartier matrices, and independent extension-field point-count congruences.
scientific_limitations: Fixed base field F3; fixed ambient quadric and minimal (4,4) embedding; no claim about abstract isomorphism, full Newton polygons, or other characteristics. The 264-equation total is already numerically covered by the 2025 paper; the claimed new result is the Jacobian invariant stratification and ordinary-orbit refinement. Independent external validation is not performed.
title: The Cartier-rank dichotomy for smooth ternary space-filling biquartics
